from.place: The resolution-section comparison: normalized Hom cocycles, their restriction, and their augmentation-preserving pullback transfer, below the Mayer-Vietoris comparison. Substep: open-to-open restriction of normalized comparisons.

title: Open to open restriction of canonical resolution comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme, G an abelian sheaf on its small etale site, I an injective resolution of G, and c a resolution-section comparison normalized on Hom cocycles [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. For every pair of opens A contained in B, natural-number degree q, and class x in H^q(I(B)), applying c.openEquiv A q after homology of section restriction B to A equals openCohomologyRestriction (A ≤ B) G q applied after c.openEquiv B q. The restriction includes the canonical inverse-image composition transport [lem-weil-pbc-open-cohomology-whole-restriction-naturality].

proof.text: Represent the class by a cycle z in the resolution evaluated at B, using surjectivity of homologyπ in abelian groups. The free-sheaf sections adjunction identifies the section iCycles q z with a morphism f from the free sheaf on B to I.cocomplex.X q. Naturality in the coefficient sheaf and the cycle equation show that f composed with the differential is zero. Let a be the image of the inclusion A to B under etaleOpenFreeSheaf X. Naturality of the free-sheaf adjunction identifies a composed with f with the restriction of the original section. Naturality of homologyπ identifies the resulting cycle class with the homology map of etaleSectionMap. Apply c.open_cocycle at A and B. The formula I.mk₀_comp_extMk expresses the class at A as precomposition of I.extMk f by a. Expand the two etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap expressions. Pulling back a along A.ι and precomposing with the identity generator at A equals pulling back the identity generator at B along X.homOfLE h, with the constant-sheaf and inverse-image composition comparisons inserted. This generator equality is already proved by `etaleOpenFreeSheafUnit_coherence B A h`: its left side contains the direct pullback followed by the composition comparison, and its right side contains the constant comparison followed by the pulled-back unit. Use Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp and Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀ to move precomposition through inverse image. Substitute the generator equality. Then `Ext.exactFunctorCompositionComparison` for the two inverse-image functors and upperStarComp replaces the successive Ext pullbacks by the direct one. Ext associativity and cancellation of the composition isomorphism give cohomologyMap along X.homOfLE h followed by the inverse composition comparison, exactly openCohomologyRestriction. Surjectivity of homologyπ finishes for every class. This argument includes q = 0, A = B, empty opens, and the zero sheaf.

lean.statement: theorem resolutionSection_canonical_open_to_open {X : Scheme.{u}} (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (I : InjectiveResolution G) (c : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I) : ∀ (A B : X.Opens) (h : A ≤ B) q x, c.openEquiv A q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (etaleSectionMap (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (X.homOfLE h) (X.homOfLE_ι _) : Scheme.Etale.mk A.ι ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk B.ι) I.cocomplex) q x) = openCohomologyRestriction h G q (c.openEquiv B q x)
